description: Create a B-tree index on `orders(customer_id, created_at)` to support a new dashboard querying the last 30 days of orders per customer. The `orders` table contains 200 million rows and receives ~3,000 writes/second. Must use `CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY` to avoid blocking writes. Index build is expected to take 45-90 minutes. Risk factors: deadlocks during concurrent index build, autovacuum pressure, increased WAL generation, and potential query planner regressions. Verify index usage with `pg_stat_user_indexes` before and after. Rollback plan must include DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY. Tools available: pg_stat_activity, pg_stat_user_indexes, EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS), auto_explain module.
